title: CDEG: Learning Decision-Critical Evidence for Long-Horizon Diagnostic Agents
summary: Unlike static medical question answering, long-horizon diagnosis captures the sequential nature of clinical practice: evidence is progressively acquired, integrated, and evaluated over multiple rounds of interaction before reaching a final diagnosis. However, existing doctor agents often fail when critical evidence is either not acquired or not adequately incorporated into diagnostic reasoning. Recent agentic approaches attempt to address these failures by reusing historical trajectories or distilled memories. But their diagnostic gains remain constrained because such experience may contain noisy or incidental information and is typically reused without validating which evidence actually drives diagnostic decisions. To address this limitation, we introduce CDEG, a graph-based framework that learns reusable decision-critical evidence from historical diagnostic trajectories. CDEG contrasts successful and failed trajectories from the same case to identify candidate evidence, validates their diagnostic impact through controlled counterfactual interventions, and organizes the resulting diagnosis--evidence--action relations into a structured graph. During inference, CDEG tracks the evolving patient evidence state to retrieve relevant diagnostic relations and selectively guide missing evidence acquisition or overlooked evidence reappraisal. Across in-domain and out-of-distribution benchmarks with multiple doctor agent backbones, CDEG consistently improves diagnostic performance, achieving up to an 11.5% accuracy gain over vanilla agents. These results demonstrate that reliable long-horizon diagnosis requires moving beyond trajectory-level experience reuse toward evidence-level learning of the factors that truly shape clinical decisions.
tldr: CDEG is a graph-based framework that learns decision-critical evidence from historical diagnostic trajectories, using contrastive learning and counterfactual interventions to improve long-horizon medical diagnosis, achieving up to 11.5% accuracy gains over baseline agent methods.
tldr_zh: CDEG是一种基于图的框架，通过学习历史诊断轨迹中的决策关键证据，利用对比学习和反事实干预改进长时序医学诊断，相较于基线智能体方法实现了最高11.5%的准确率提升。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
与静态医学问答不同，长程诊断捕捉了临床实践的序贯特性：证据在多轮交互中逐步获取、整合和评估，最终达成诊断结论。然而，现有医生智能体在关键证据未被获取或未充分融入诊断推理时常会失效。近期基于智能体的方法试图通过复用历史轨迹或蒸馏记忆来应对这些失败，但其诊断提升仍受局限，因为此类经验可能包含噪声或偶然信息，且通常未经验证哪些证据实际驱动诊断决策便被复用。为克服这一局限，我们提出CDEG——一种基于图的框架，能够从历史诊断轨迹中学习可复用的决策关键证据。CDEG通过对比同一案例的成功与失败轨迹来识别候选证据，通过受控反事实干预验证其诊断影响，并将由此产生的诊断-证据-动作关系组织成结构化图。在推理阶段，CDEG追踪患者证据状态的演变以检索相关诊断关系，并选择性引导缺失证据的获取或被忽视证据的重新评估。在多个医生智能体骨干网络的域内和分布外基准测试中，CDEG持续提升诊断性能，相较于原始智能体准确率提升最高达11.5%。这些结果表明，可靠的长程诊断需要超越轨迹级经验复用，转向证据级学习真正塑造临床决策的关键因素。

title: Large-Small Model Collaboration for Zero-Shot Surgical Phase Recognition
summary: Task-specific lightweight models for surgical phase recognition excel at capturing temporal dynamics but generalize poorly under domain shift. Conversely, surgical foundation models (FMs) offer superior transferability via large-scale pretraining, yet their lack of explicit temporal modeling often yields temporally inconsistent predictions, leading to degraded performance. To exploit the complementary strengths of both paradigms, we propose \textbf{La}rge-\textbf{S}mall \textbf{T}emporal adaptation (\textbf{LaST}), a novel large-small collaborative framework that enables zero-shot adaptation to unseen clinical domains. In LaST, the FM initiates the pipeline by generating frame-level phase priors that serve as initial weak supervision. To effectively utilize these noisy phase priors, we introduce an iterative temporal refinement scheme that integrates dynamic quality control to filter reliable predictions and dual-model cross-learning to mitigate confirmation bias. Simultaneously, the lightweight model leverages its intrinsic temporal modeling ability to progressively correct inconsistent predictions and enhance overall accuracy across iterations. At the end, a cycle replay strategy is employed to close the loop: the refined, more accurate predictions are utilized as upgraded supervision signals for the subsequent iterations, fostering a self-reinforcing evolution of both label quality and model capability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LaST achieves robust adaptation to unseen domains for zero-shot surgical phase recognition, outperforming the baseline (PeskaVLP) by 24.85\%-43.17\% in accuracy and even surpassing fully supervised linear probing and several state-of-the-art few-shot approaches. Codes will be released at https://github.com/YIYIZH/LaST.
tldr: Proposes LaST, a large-small model collaborative framework that uses a surgical foundation model to generate noisy phase priors and a lightweight model to iteratively refine them via temporal modeling, achieving zero-shot adaptation for surgical phase recognition with significant performance gains.
tldr_zh: 提出LaST框架，利用手术基础模型生成噪声相位先验，轻量模型通过时间建模迭代优化，实现零样本手术阶段识别，性能提升显著。
summary_zh:
**摘要：**  
针对手术阶段识别任务，特定任务的轻量级模型擅长捕捉时间动态，但在领域迁移下泛化能力较差。相反，手术基础模型通过大规模预训练展现出优越的可迁移性，但其缺乏显式时间建模，常导致预测在时间上不一致，从而性能下降。为利用两种范式的互补优势，我们提出**大-小时间适应**（LaST），一种新颖的大-小模型协作框架，能够实现对未见临床领域的零样本适应。在LaST中，基础模型启动流程，生成作为初始弱监督的帧级阶段先验。为有效利用这些含噪阶段先验，我们引入一种迭代时间精化方案，该方案整合动态质量控制以筛选可靠预测，并通过双模型交叉学习减轻确认偏误。同时，轻量级模型利用其内在的时间建模能力，逐步纠正不一致预测，并在迭代中提升整体准确性。最后，采用循环回放策略形成闭环：精炼后更准确的预测作为后续迭代的升级版监督信号，推动标签质量与模型能力的自我强化演化。大量实验表明，LaST在零样本手术阶段识别中实现了对未见领域的鲁棒适应，准确率较基线（PeskaVLP）提升24.85%–43.17%，甚至超越全监督线性探测及多种最先进的少样本方法。代码将发布在 https://github.com/YIYIZH/LaST。

title: Gated Activation Steering for Reducing Sycophancy & Hallucination in Medical Question Answering
summary: Sycophancy and hallucination are persistent failure modes of Large Language Models (LLMs) across domains. However, it becomes particularly consequential in clinical question answering, where responses must remain grounded in the provided context and robust to user pressure. Hallucination can introduce information that is unsupported by the context, while sycophancy can cause a model to abandon a previously correct answer when challenged by the user. Existing approaches, such as prompt-based safeguards and always-on activation steering, often address these behaviors separately or apply interventions broadly across turns, which can unnecessarily deteriorate responses that were already correct. To address these limitations within a single framework, we employ Inference Time Intervention (ITI) to jointly control both behaviors by learning separate steering directions for hallucination and sycophancy from contrastive clinical pairs and applying them to causally verified attention heads. During runtime, behavior-specific gates then determine when intervention is needed: the hallucination component mitigates unsupported claims, while the sycophancy component mitigates answer shifts caused by user pressure. We evaluate this framework on clinical questions grounded in EHR data while keeping the model weights frozen. Across all evaluation settings, we conducted 15,900 model-response runs. Across 600 pressure trajectories for the 4-billion-parameter model, the unsteered model caved in 570 cases. At the same time, gated steering helped it last longer in 551 of them. It held its ground under pressure at levels comparable to those of models with more than 100 billion parameters, showing that targeted inference-time steering can improve robustness without intervening at every turn.
tldr: This paper proposes a gated activation steering method to jointly reduce sycophancy and hallucination in LLMs for clinical question answering, using inference-time intervention on specific attention heads with behavior-specific gates to intervene only when needed, achieving robustness comparable to models with over 100 billion parameters.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种门控激活引导方法，用于在临床问答中联合减少大语言模型的谄媚和幻觉问题，通过推理时干预特定注意力头并设置行为特定门控仅在必要时干预，实现了与千亿参数模型相当的鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 谄媚和幻觉是大语言模型（LLMs）在多个领域中持续存在的失败模式。然而，在临床问答中，这一问题尤为严重，因为回答必须严格基于所提供的上下文，并能抵御用户的施压。幻觉可能引入上下文不支持的信息，而谄媚则可能导致模型在受到用户质疑时放弃先前正确的答案。现有的方法，例如基于提示的保护措施和始终开启的激活引导，通常分别处理这些行为，或在多轮对话中宽泛地应用干预，这可能会不必要地削弱原本正确的回答。为了在单一框架内解决这些局限性，我们采用推理时干预（ITI），通过学习来自对比临床对的独立引导方向，并将其应用于经过因果验证的注意力头，从而联合控制幻觉和谄媚这两种行为。在运行时，行为特定的门控机制决定何时需要干预：幻觉组件用于缓解无上下文支持的表述，而谄媚组件则用于缓解由用户施压导致的答案偏移。我们在基于电子健康记录（EHR）数据的临床问题上评估了这一框架，同时保持模型权重冻结。在所有评估设置中，我们共执行了15,900次模型响应运行。对于40亿参数的模型，在600条压力轨迹中，未经引导的模型在570个案例中屈服。与此同时，门控引导帮助其在551个案例中坚持了更长时间。它在压力下坚守立场的能力可与超过1000亿参数的模型相媲美，这表明有针对性的推理时引导可以在不干预每一轮对话的情况下提升鲁棒性。

title: MediSkill-Evo: Process-Constrained Self-Evolution for Evidence-Grounded Clinical Interaction
summary: Interactive clinical agents operate under partial observability, so reliable care depends on reaching the correct diagnosis through evidence-grounded, safe interactions. Yet existing agents struggle to convert experience into reusable process knowledge with explicit provenance and authority. To address this gap, we introduce MediSkill-Evo, which self-evolves governed process knowledge without fine-tuning the backbone. It realizes this self-evolution by updating clinical, process, symbolic, and visual knowledge in four typed banks under type-specific validation and scope rules. The Process-Constrained Preference Harness then turns validated knowledge into action by grounding candidates in evidence and prioritizing safer decisions. We evaluate on 300 MIMIC-IV-derived FullChain encounters, 180 hard-isolation conditions covering six process obligations, and 100 multimodal NEJM image-diagnosis cases. On Qwen FullChain, MediSkill-Evo improves diagnosis accuracy by 7.81% and treatment-intent coverage by 70.67% over the best-performing prior agent, while reducing critical failures by 43.04%. Under stress, it improves the stress-process composite by 7.77% and required-action completion by 12.41% over the best-performing agent for each metric, with stronger patient-fact, temporal-evidence, and triage-red-flag recovery and no controller-scored errors in unavailable-evidence, treatment, and triage safety checks. On multimodal NEJM diagnosis, MediSkill-Evo with optional MedSAM localization improves diagnosis accuracy by 2.56% and core score by 18.96% over the best-performing memory agent. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/mediskill-evo_anonymous-68E7.
tldr: MediSkill-Evo introduces a self-evolving clinical agent that updates process knowledge across four typed banks without fine-tuning, using a Process-Constrained Preference Harness to ground decisions in evidence. It significantly improves diagnosis accuracy, treatment coverage, and safety over prior agents on MIMIC-IV and NEJM image-diagnosis benchmarks.
tldr_zh: MediSkill-Evo 提出了一种自我进化的临床智能体，在不进行微调的情况下更新四个类型化知识库中的过程知识，并利用过程约束偏好选择机制将决策基于证据。在 MIMIC-IV 和 NEJM 图像诊断基准上，它显著提高了诊断准确性、治疗覆盖率和安全性。
summary_zh:
摘要：
交互式临床代理在部分可观察性条件下运行，因此可靠的护理依赖于通过基于证据的安全交互达成正确诊断。然而，现有代理难以将经验转化为具有明确来源和权威性的可复用过程知识。为弥补这一不足，我们提出MediSkill-Evo，它在不微调主干网络的情况下实现过程知识的自我演化。该模型通过将临床知识、过程知识、符号知识和视觉知识更新到四个类型化知识库中，并依据类型特定的验证与范围规则，从而实现自我演化。随后，过程约束偏好工具通过将候选方案锚定于证据并优先选择更安全的决策，将验证后的知识转化为行动。我们在300个源自MIMIC-IV的FullChain诊疗记录、180个涵盖六种流程义务的硬隔离条件以及100个多模态NEJM影像诊断病例上进行了评估。在Qwen FullChain上，MediSkill-Evo相较于先前最优代理，诊断准确率提升7.81%，治疗意图覆盖率提升70.67%，同时关键失误降低43.04%。在压力测试下，相较于各指标上的最优代理，其压力过程综合指标提升7.77%，必要动作完成率提升12.41%，并在患者事实、时序证据、分诊红旗恢复方面表现更强，且在不可用证据、治疗和分诊安全检查中未出现控制器评分错误。在多模态NEJM诊断中，结合可选MedSAM定位的MediSkill-Evo相较于最优记忆型代理，诊断准确率提升2.56%，核心评分提升18.96%。代码见 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/mediskill-evo_anonymous-68E7。

title: From Multimodal Observation to Interpretable Suggestions: Counterfactual Time-Expanded Relational Modeling of Surgical Teams
summary: In surgery, patient safety is threatened not only by technical issues but also by poor teamwork. However, existing surgical AI-based solutions focus mainly on visual workflow and technical execution, neglecting the modeling of team interactions and missing opportunities to actively support clinicians in improving their teamwork skills. To address this gap, we propose a tempo-relational framework for modeling surgical team dynamics from multimodal observations. By leveraging Time-Expanded graphs, the approach captures both relational structure and temporal evolution, achieving strong expressivity while remaining robust in the low-data regime typical of surgical settings. Beyond prediction, such modeling enables the generation of efficient, interpretable, and actionable suggestions for clinicians. More specifically, we generate suggestions via a counterfactual procedure that identifies minimal yet structured changes in individual behaviors and interaction patterns associated with improvements in team performance. Experiments with simulated surgical procedures show that our approach improves predictive performance in diverse behavioral and interaction goals while offering meaningful insights into team dynamics. This work advances surgical AI beyond outcome-driven prediction towards a socially grounded, team-centric, and actionable paradigm to better understand and support the development of team skills in surgical settings.
tldr: This paper proposes a tempo-relational framework using Time-Expanded graphs and counterfactual reasoning to model surgical team dynamics from multimodal observations, enabling interpretable suggestions for improving teamwork in surgery.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种使用时间扩展图与反事实推理的时空关系框架，从多模态观测中建模手术团队动态，生成可解释的建议以改善手术中的团队协作。
summary_zh: 在手术中，患者安全不仅受到技术问题的影响，也受到团队协作不佳的威胁。然而，现有的基于人工智能的手术解决方案主要关注视觉工作流程和技术执行，忽视了团队交互的建模，并错失了主动支持临床医生提升团队协作技能的机会。为填补这一空白，我们提出了一种从多模态观测数据中建模手术团队动态的时序关系框架。通过利用时间扩展图，该方法能够同时捕捉关系结构和时间演变，在手术场景典型的低数据量条件下保持强大表现力的同时兼具稳健性。除了预测功能外，这种建模还能为临床医生生成高效、可解释且可操作的建议。具体而言，我们通过反事实分析生成建议，该过程识别出与团队绩效改善相关的个体行为及交互模式中的最小结构化变化。基于模拟手术流程的实验表明，我们的方法在多种行为和交互目标上提升了预测性能，同时为团队动态提供了有意义的洞察。这项工作推动了手术人工智能从结果驱动的预测范式，迈向一种基于社会情境、以团队为中心且可操作的范式，从而更好地理解并支持手术环境中团队技能的发展。

title: Optimize Surgical Triplet Recognition: A Knowledge-Driven Mixture-of-Experts Solution
summary: Surgical action triplet recognition constitutes a critical task in context-aware robot-assisted surgery, facilitating automatic surgical action perception by identifying instrument, verb, target, and their association. However, existing works struggle to analyze such complex surgical scenes due to three main issues: (1) component-level optimization conflicts caused by entangled feature spaces, (2) category-level optimization conflicts arising from severe data imbalance, and (3) lack of domain knowledge guidance that limits model interpretability and robustness. To address these challenges, we propose a Mixture-of-Experts-guided Co-Optimization (\textit{MoeCo}) framework powered by knowledge-driven learning. Within the co-optimization pipeline, to first mitigate component-level conflicts, we introduce a component-tailored adapter that disentangles task-specific features across spatial-temporal regimes, facilitating effective component specialization. Next, we develop a coordinated gradient learning strategy to handle category-level conflicts, which adaptively rebalances positive-negative gradients to enhance the perception of rare categories. Notably, inspired by surgical domain expertise, we introduce a knowledge-driven mixture-of-experts mechanism that dynamically integrates multimodal large language model-guided knowledge via activated experts, thereby enriching the co-optimization pipeline with more expressive and robust representations. Extensive experiments on the public CholecT45 and CholecT50 datasets confirm the effectiveness of the proposed co-optimization pipeline and the superiority of dynamic priors integration via the knowledge-driven mixture-of-experts mechanism.
tldr: This paper proposes a knowledge-driven mixture-of-experts framework (MoeCo) for surgical action triplet recognition, addressing component-level and category-level optimization conflicts via component-tailored adapters and coordinated gradient learning, and integrating multimodal LLM-guided domain knowledge for robust representations, achieving state-of-the-art results on CholecT45 and CholecT50.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种知识驱动的混合专家框架（MoeCo），用于手术动作三元组识别，通过组件定制适配器和协调梯度学习解决组件级和类别级的优化冲突，并整合多模态大语言模型引导的领域知识以获得鲁棒的表示，在CholecT45和CholecT50数据集上取得了最优结果。
summary_zh: 手术动作三元组识别是上下文感知机器人辅助手术中的关键任务，通过识别器械、动作、目标及其关联来实现自动手术动作感知。然而，现有方法在分析此类复杂手术场景时面临三个主要问题：（1）特征空间纠缠导致的组件级优化冲突；（2）严重数据不平衡引发的类别级优化冲突；（3）缺乏领域知识引导限制了模型的可解释性和鲁棒性。针对这些挑战，我们提出了一种知识驱动学习驱动的专家混合引导协同优化框架（MoeCo）。在协同优化流程中，为缓解组件级冲突，我们引入了组件定制适配器，该适配器在时空域中解耦任务特定特征，促进有效的组件专业化。随后，我们开发了协调梯度学习策略来处理类别级冲突，该策略自适应地平衡正负梯度以增强稀有类别的感知。值得注意的是，受手术领域专业知识的启发，我们引入了知识驱动的专家混合机制，该机制通过激活的专家动态整合多模态大语言模型引导的知识，从而为协同优化流程注入更具表达力和鲁棒性的表征。在公开的CholecT45和CholecT50数据集上的大量实验验证了所提协同优化流程的有效性，以及通过知识驱动专家混合机制集成动态先验的优越性。

title: VeCAS: Vessel-Focused Contrast-Free Angiogram Synthesis for Vascular Interventions
summary: X-ray angiography relies on iodinated contrast agents to visualize vascular structures during image-guided interventions. However, contrast administration carries risks of adverse events, motivating the development of contrast-free alternatives. Generating X-ray angiograms directly from non-contrast X-ray images offers a potential solution, but existing approaches remain limited by (i) insufficient control over vascular localization and (ii) inefficient modeling of redundant background content. To address these challenges, we propose VeCAS, a two-stage vessel-focused contrast-free angiogram synthesis framework that separates vascular structure localization from angiographic appearance synthesis. In Stage I, a discriminative model localizes vascular structures in non-contrast X-ray images, while cross-modality latent distillation transfers vessel-sensitive knowledge from X-ray angiograms during training. In Stage II, a vessel-focused inpainting model synthesizes angiographic appearance within the localized vascular regions while preserving the non-vascular background. Experiments on an in-house lower-limb vascular intervention dataset show that VeCAS outperforms the comparison methods in terms of vascular structural fidelity and image quality. Visual Turing tests and physician assessments indicate the perceptual realism of the synthesized angiograms. In addition, robotic guidewire navigation experiments in vascular phantoms show that VeCAS guidance reduces the time to target by 41.4% and the number of operation steps by 40.7% compared with non-contrast guidance. Together, these results suggest the potential of VeCAS to serve as ``meta contrast agent'' for vascular interventions.
tldr: VeCAS proposes a two-stage framework to synthesize X-ray angiograms from non-contrast X-ray images, first localizing vessels via discriminative model with cross-modality distillation, then inpainting angiographic appearance, achieving significant reduction in guidewire navigation time and steps in vascular phantoms.
tldr_zh: VeCAS提出了一种两阶段框架，从非造影X光图像合成血管造影图，首先通过判别模型和跨模态蒸馏定位血管，然后修复造影外观，在血管体模中实现了导丝导航时间和步骤的显著减少。
summary_zh: X射线血管造影在图像引导介入治疗中依赖碘化造影剂来显示血管结构。然而，造影剂的使用存在不良事件风险，这推动了无造影剂替代方案的开发。直接从非造影X射线图像生成X射线血管造影图提供了一种潜在解决方案，但现有方法仍受限于：(i) 对血管定位控制不足，(ii) 背景冗余内容建模效率低下。为应对这些挑战，我们提出VeCAS——一种两阶段、聚焦血管的无造影血管造影合成框架，将血管结构定位与血管造影外观生成相分离。在第一阶段，一个判别模型在非造影X射线图像中定位血管结构，同时跨模态潜在蒸馏在训练过程中从X射线血管造影图中转移血管敏感知识。在第二阶段，一个聚焦血管的修复模型在定位的血管区域内合成血管造影外观，同时保留非血管背景。在内部下肢血管介入数据集上的实验表明，VeCAS在血管结构保真度和图像质量方面优于对比方法。视觉图灵测试和医师评估表明，合成的血管造影图像具有感知真实性。此外，在血管模型中的机器人导丝导航实验显示，与非造影引导相比，VeCAS引导将到达目标的时间减少了41.4%，操作步骤数减少了40.7%。综合这些结果，表明VeCAS有潜力作为血管介入的"元造影剂"。

title: SymmAdapt: Symmetrical Flow Matching for Source-Free Domain Adaptation in Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Domain shift across imaging modalities and acquisition sites remains a significant barrier to the clinical deployment of segmentation models. Source-free unsupervised domain adaptation (SFUDA) addresses this by adapting a pretrained model to an unlabeled target domain without requiring access to sensitive source data. We introduce a novel SFUDA framework built on Symmetrical Flow Matching, a unified generative model that segments an input image and synthesizes a source-like image from a mask within the same learned flow. By initializing inference from a domain-agnostic Gaussian origin, the model preserves structural consistency across domains and grounds predictions in learned anatomy rather than shifted texture statistics. Our pipeline leverages this symmetry to generate reliable pseudo-labels and corresponding source-like synthetic images from unlabeled target data, creating a generative replay buffer that anchors source knowledge during a generative self-training stage that fine-tunes on a joint set of real target and synthetic source-like images. We evaluate on abdominal multi-organ and cardiac segmentation, covering cross-modality MRI<->CT shifts, and multi-site prostate segmentation. Our approach outperforms SFUDA baselines and is competitive with conventional UDA methods.
tldr: SymmAdapt introduces a symmetrical flow matching framework for source-free unsupervised domain adaptation in medical image segmentation, generating pseudo-labels and synthetic source-like images to adapt pretrained models to new domains without accessing source data.
tldr_zh: SymmAdapt提出了一种对称流匹配框架，用于医学图像分割中的无源无监督域适应，通过生成伪标签和合成源域图像，在不访问源数据的情况下将预训练模型适应到新域。
summary_zh: 跨成像模态和采集站点的域偏移仍然是分割模型临床部署的重要障碍。无源无监督域适应（SFUDA）通过将预训练模型适配到无标注目标域来解决此问题，且无需访问敏感源数据。我们提出了一种基于对称流匹配的新型SFUDA框架，这是一种统一的生成模型，能够在同一学习流内对输入图像进行分割，并从掩码合成类源图像。通过从域无关的高斯原点初始化推理，该模型在跨域时保持结构一致性，并将预测锚定在学习到的解剖结构而非偏移的纹理统计量上。我们的流程利用这种对称性，从无标注目标数据生成可靠的伪标签及对应的类源合成图像，构建生成式重放缓冲区，在生成式自训练阶段（对真实目标图像与合成类源图像的联合集进行微调）中锚定源知识。我们在腹部多器官和心脏分割任务上进行了评估，涵盖跨模态MRI↔CT迁移以及多站点前列腺分割。我们的方法优于SFUDA基线，并与传统无监督域适应方法竞争力相当。

title: Improving O-RADS Risk Stratification from Ultrasound Reports: A Comparative Evaluation of Hybrid versus End-to-End LLM Reasoning Strategies
summary: Background: Automating clinical guideline-based decision-making with large language models (LLMs) remains challenging because of reliability, hallucination, and limited interpretability. We compared the performance of LLMs and reasoning strategies for automated Ovarian-Adnexal Reporting and Data System (O-RADS) classification from free-text pelvic ultrasound reports. Methods: In this retrospective study, consecutive patients with ovarian masses who underwent pelvic ultrasound were included. Eight LLMs were tested with three reasoning strategies: implicit-knowledge end-to-end, rule-informed end-to-end, and a feature-based hybrid architecture that decoupled feature extraction from rule-based classification. The reference standard was O-RADS categorization established by expert consensus. Results: A total of 310 women with 390 ovarian masses were evaluated. The feature-based hybrid architecture using Gemini 3.6 Flash demonstrated the best performance, achieving an accuracy of 99.2% (387 of 390) and almost perfect agreement with the reference standard (weighted kappa = 1.00; 95% CI: 0.99-1.00). Its performance surpassed that of original clinical reports (accuracy, 87.7% [342 of 390]; weighted kappa = 0.94; 95% CI: 0.91-0.96) and end-to-end LLM strategies (accuracy range, 65.6% [256 of 390] to 95.9% [374 of 390]). For structured feature extraction, Gemini 3.6 Flash demonstrated higher overall accuracy than Claude Fable 5 (98.9% vs 97.8%; P < 0.001). The hybrid architecture reduced misclassification errors and mitigated the overstaging tendency observed in original reports. Conclusion: The feature-based hybrid LLM architecture that separates clinical feature extraction from deterministic guideline execution enables highly accurate, reliable, and interpretable automated O-RADS classification, providing a promising approach for standardized, guideline-based clinical decision-making.
tldr: This paper evaluates LLM-based strategies for automated O-RADS classification from ultrasound reports, finding that a hybrid architecture separating feature extraction from rule-based classification achieves near-perfect accuracy (99.2%) and outperforms both original reports and end-to-end LLM approaches.
tldr_zh: 本文评估了基于大语言模型的超声报告自动O-RADS分类策略，发现将特征提取与基于规则的分类分离的混合架构实现了接近完美的准确率（99.2%），优于原始报告和端到端大语言模型方法。
summary_zh:
**摘要：**  
**背景：** 基于临床指南的大语言模型（LLM）自动化决策仍面临可靠性、幻觉和可解释性有限等挑战。我们比较了不同LLM及推理策略在从自由文本盆腔超声报告中自动进行卵巢-附件报告和数据系统（O-RADS）分类方面的性能。  
**方法：** 本回顾性研究纳入连续就诊的卵巢肿块并行盆腔超声检查的患者。采用三种推理策略测试了八种LLM：隐式知识端到端、规则引导端到端，以及一种将特征提取与基于规则的分类解耦的基于特征的混合架构。参考标准为专家共识确定的O-RADS分类。  
**结果：** 共评估了310名女性的390个卵巢肿块。采用Gemini 3.6 Flash的基于特征的混合架构表现最佳，准确率达99.2%（387/390），与参考标准几乎完全一致（加权卡帕系数=1.00；95% CI：0.99-1.00）。其性能优于原始临床报告（准确率87.7% [342/390]；加权卡帕系数=0.94；95% CI：0.91-0.96）和端到端LLM策略（准确率范围：65.6% [256/390] 至 95.9% [374/390]）。在结构化特征提取方面，Gemini 3.6 Flash的整体准确率高于Claude Fable 5（98.9% vs 97.8%；P < 0.001）。混合架构减少了错误分类，并缓解了原始报告中观察到的过度分期倾向。  
**结论：** 将临床特征提取与确定性指南执行相分离的基于特征的混合LLM架构，能够实现高度准确、可靠且可解释的自动化O-RADS分类，为标准化、基于指南的临床决策提供了一种有前景的方法。

title: Primal--Dual Alternating Neural Learning for Timely Classification with Performance Guarantees
summary: Timely risk classification is essential in many clinical monitoring settings, where decisions must balance the benefit of classifying patients early for subsequent intervention against the value of observing additional data. Yet most existing statistical and machine-learning methods are designed for fully observed trajectories and offer limited control over key operating characteristics such as sensitivity, specificity, and monitoring cost. We cast the sequential classification problem within a multi-objective optimization framework targeting these three criteria. We characterize the optimal decision rule through a value recursion that quantifies, at each time point, the trade-off between immediate classification and continued monitoring. To estimate the rule from data, we formulate a constrained optimization problem that maximizes specificity while enforcing prespecified sensitivity and monitoring-cost constraints. We then develop an estimation procedure that employs a recurrent neural network to approximate the evolving value processes and a primal--dual updating scheme to satisfy the performance constraints. Through simulation studies and an application to continuous glucose monitoring for hypoglycemia risk prediction, we demonstrate that the proposed method yields accurate and timely sequential decision rules that adhere to the desired operating characteristics.
tldr: This paper proposes a primal-dual alternating neural learning method for timely sequential classification in clinical monitoring, which maximizes specificity under sensitivity and cost constraints using RNNs and achieves performance guarantees.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种原始-对偶交替神经学习方法，用于临床监测中的及时序贯分类，通过循环神经网络在灵敏度和代价约束下最大化特异性，并提供性能保证。
summary_zh: 摘要：及时的风险分类在许多临床监测场景中至关重要，此类决策需在两类目标间取得平衡：一是通过早期分类使患者及时获得干预的收益，二是通过观察更多数据获取的信息价值。然而，现有大多数统计和机器学习方法均针对完全观测轨迹设计，对灵敏度、特异度及监测成本等关键操作特性的控制能力有限。本文将序列分类问题纳入一个以这三个准则为目标的多目标优化框架。我们通过一个价值递归函数来刻画最优决策规则，该函数在每个时间点量化即时分类与持续监测之间的权衡。为从数据中估计该规则，我们构建了一个约束优化问题，在满足预设灵敏度和监测成本约束的前提下最大化特异度。进而，我们开发了一套估计流程，采用循环神经网络逼近动态价值过程，并利用原始-对偶更新方案来满足性能约束。通过模拟研究以及一项针对低血糖风险预测的连续血糖监测应用，我们证明了所提方法能生成准确且及时的序列决策规则，并符合所需的操作特性。

title: Teaching LLMs How ICU Physicians Approach Clinical Reasoning Through OMOP-Aligned Retrieval Improves Reasoning Across Clinical Domains
summary: Clinical decision-making relies on identifying relevant patient information to guide diagnosis and treatment, a challenge that is especially difficult in the data-dense and rapidly changing intensive care unit (ICU). Large language models (LLMs) could support this task. However, existing applications and datasets mostly emphasize surface-level retrieval or factual recall rather than the inductive and deductive reasoning clinicians practice to select and reason over decision-relevant evidence. We hypothesized that training LLMs on expert ICU reasoning could yield clinical reasoning skills that generalize beyond critical care. Here we introduce ICU-REACT, a reasoning dataset developed with 19 clinicians through a clinician-in-the-loop framework to teach LLMs to perform information retrieval and context-aware clinical reasoning in the ICU. Using ICU-REACT, we fine-tuned Clin-REACT models spanning 8B-70B parameters and three model families. Across five clinical reasoning benchmarks, Clin-REACT consistently outperformed its backbone models and open-source general-purpose and medical LLMs. Gains extended to different tasks including script concordance tests, and downstream diagnosis and treatment tasks. These findings suggest that expert reasoning supervision in critical care can improve broader clinical reasoning, although prospective evaluation is needed before real-world clinical use.
tldr: The paper introduces ICU-REACT, a clinician-in-the-loop reasoning dataset for training LLMs to perform clinical reasoning like ICU physicians, and shows that fine-tuned Clin-REACT models outperform baselines across multiple clinical benchmarks, even generalizing beyond critical care.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了ICU-REACT，一个由临床医生参与构建的推理数据集，用于训练LLM像ICU医生一样进行临床推理。微调后的Clin-REACT模型在多个临床基准上超越基线，并且推理能力可泛化到重症监护之外。
summary_zh: 临床决策依赖于识别相关患者信息以指导诊断和治疗，这一挑战在数据密集且快速变化的重症监护病房（ICU）中尤为困难。大语言模型（LLMs）或可辅助完成此任务。然而，现有应用和数据集大多侧重于表面信息检索或事实回忆，而非临床医生在选择和推理决策相关证据时所采用的归纳与演绎推理过程。我们假设，基于专家ICU推理训练LLMs能够产生超越重症医学范畴的临床推理能力。为此，我们引入了ICU-REACT——一个通过临床医生参与框架与19名临床医生共同开发的推理数据集，用于训练LLMs在ICU中执行信息检索和情境感知的临床推理。利用ICU-REACT，我们微调了参数规模从8B到70B、涵盖三个模型系列的Clin-REACT模型。在五个临床推理基准测试中，Clin-REACT始终优于其基础模型以及开源通用与医学LLMs。其性能提升扩展至不同任务，包括脚本一致性测试、下游诊断与治疗任务。这些发现表明，重症医学中的专家推理监督能够改善更广泛的临床推理能力，但在实际临床应用前仍需进行前瞻性评估。

title: Future Querying: Can LLMs Serve as Implicit Medical World Models?
summary: Traditional clinical prediction models rely on task-specific pipelines and curated, structured data, which scale poorly and underutilize unstructured text. To address this, we introduce future querying, a paradigm that probes whether large language models (LLMs) can function as implicit medical world models by evaluating their ability to answer time-indexed clinical queries about a patient's future. Our framework operates on unstructured clinical documentation using endpoint-agnostic training, enabling a single model to answer diverse clinical queries over patient trajectories without manual feature engineering or task-specific retraining. We show that small, locally fine-tuned open-weight models can match or approach larger proprietary systems, making the framework suitable for privacy-preserving, on-premise deployment. Evaluated on a new synthetic medical reports dataset and real ICU notes from the MIMIC-IV dataset, our results provide encouraging evidence that LLMs can capture aspects of clinical dynamics.
tldr: This paper introduces 'future querying,' a paradigm where LLMs are used as implicit medical world models to answer time-indexed clinical queries from unstructured text, showing that small fine-tuned models can match larger ones in predicting patient trajectories without task-specific retraining.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了‘未来查询’范式，将大语言模型作为隐式医学世界模型，通过非结构化临床文本回答带有时间索引的临床查询，表明小规模微调模型在无需任务特定重训练的情况下可媲美大型模型。
summary_zh: 传统临床预测模型依赖于特定任务的工作流程和经过整理的结构化数据，这些模型扩展性差且未能充分利用非结构化文本。为解决这一问题，我们引入了未来查询这一范式，通过评估大语言模型回答关于患者未来、带时间索引的临床查询的能力，探究其能否充当隐式医学世界模型。我们的框架采用端点无关训练方式处理非结构化临床文档，使得单一模型能够回答患者病程中的各种临床查询，无需手动特征工程或针对特定任务的重新训练。我们证明，经过本地微调的小型开放权重模型能够匹配甚至接近更大的专有系统，使得该框架适用于保护隐私的本地部署。在新型合成医学报告数据集以及来自MIMIC-IV数据集的真实ICU记录上进行的评估结果表明，我们的研究提供了令人鼓舞的证据，证明大语言模型能够捕捉临床动态的某些方面。

title: Performance of a domain-specific large language model in answering patient questions in psychiatry
summary: Background This study was designed to evaluate whether a domain-specific large language model (LLM) trained exclusively on patient education resources can answer questions about psychiatric medications, in a manner superior to LLM chatbots. We developed an LLM ("MIND") fine-tuned for clinical fidelity, trained on patient education resources from authoritative medical organizations. Methods We compared the responses of MIND, ChatGPT, and OpenEvidence to patient questions about escitalopram, using two methods: (1) computer analysis according to a rubric measuring accuracy, clarity, completeness, nuance, safety, and referral appropriateness; (2) ratings from N=10 board-licensed psychiatrists on similar metrics. Results When rated by rubric, MIND was rated highest in all domains (p<0.001). When rated by psychiatrists, ChatGPT was rated accurate more often than MIND with a negligible effect size (p=0.021, r=0.073); MIND was rated complete more often than ChatGPT with a small effect size (p<0.001, r=0.160); and MIND and ChatGPT were rated safe with the same frequency (p=0.955, r=0.002). The majority of psychiatrists preferred the responses generated by ChatGPT (57.6%) compared to MIND (42.4%, p=0.003). Conclusions MIND was able to answer many questions about escitalopram in a manner deemed accurate, complete, and safe by psychiatrists the majority of the time. However, despite MIND's ability to provide more complete responses, psychiatrists preferred ChatGPT's responses. MIND represents a step towards building safe LLM systems to enhance patient education in psychiatry.
tldr: This paper evaluates a domain-specific LLM (MIND) fine-tuned on psychiatric patient education resources for answering medication questions, finding it performs well on rubrics but psychiatrists slightly prefer ChatGPT's responses.
tldr_zh: 本文评估了一个在精神科患者教育资源上微调的领域特定大语言模型（MIND）回答药物问题的能力，发现其在评分标准上表现优异，但精神科医生略偏好ChatGPT的回答。
summary_zh:
摘要  
背景 本研究旨在评估一个仅基于患者教育资源训练的专科大语言模型（LLM）在回答精神科药物相关问题方面是否优于通用LLM聊天机器人。我们开发了一个针对临床忠实度进行微调的LLM（“MIND”），其训练数据来自权威医学机构的患者教育资源。方法 我们通过两种方法比较了MIND、ChatGPT和OpenEvidence对患者关于艾司西酞普兰问题的回答：（1）依据衡量准确性、清晰性、完整性、细致性、安全性和转诊适当性的评分标准进行计算机分析；（2）由N=10名委员会认证的精神科医生在类似指标上进行评分。结果 根据评分标准评估，MIND在所有领域的评分均最高（p<0.001）。在精神科医生评分中，ChatGPT的准确性评分高于MIND，但效应量可忽略不计（p=0.021, r=0.073）；MIND的完整性评分高于ChatGPT，效应量较小（p<0.001, r=0.160）；MIND和ChatGPT的安全性评分频率相同（p=0.955, r=0.002）。大多数精神科医生更偏好ChatGPT生成的回答（57.6%），而非MIND（42.4%, p=0.003）。结论 MIND能够在多数情况下以精神科医生认为准确、完整且安全的方式回答关于艾司西酞普兰的多个问题。然而，尽管MIND能提供更完整的回答，精神科医生仍更偏好ChatGPT的回答。MIND是构建安全LLM系统以增强精神科患者教育的一个步骤。

title: Shaping the Evolutionary Dynamics of Robot Morphology via Adaptive Control Learning
summary: Robot co-design via bi-level optimization couples within-lifetime controller learning for fitness evaluation with cross-generational morphological evolution. Prior work has established that well-adapted morphology facilitates faster control learning, a property termed morphological intelligence. Yet how control learning reciprocally shapes morphological evolution remains unexplored. This paper examines both directions for a holistic account of brain-body interplay. We first show that morphological contributions to control learning decouple into two orthogonal dimensions. We formalize the convergence speed as morphological intelligence and identify the performance ceiling as a complementary quantity termed true potential. A concise functional relation is then established to jointly characterize both quantities from individual learning curves, which, when aggregated at the population level, capture evolutionary profiles. Through extensive experiments on simulated voxel-based soft robots, we reveal that premature fitness evaluation systematically underestimates true potential and biases selection towards fast learners. This restricts design space exploration, compromising both optimization efficiency and morphological diversity. Notably, the widely recognized morphological Baldwin effect emerges as an artifact of this bias rather than a general evolutionary tendency. We therefore propose AdaControl, which monitors disproportionate selection for morphological intelligence during evolution and allocates minimally sufficient control learning for unbiased fitness evaluation. With AdaControl, a simple genetic algorithm rivals state-of-the-art generative-model-based co-design methods in discovering diverse high-performing designs while cutting computation by up to 80% versus exhaustive control.
tldr: This paper studies how control learning and morphological evolution interact in robot co-design, revealing that premature fitness evaluation biases selection towards fast learners and underestimates true potential, leading to the proposed AdaControl method that adjusts learning duration to achieve unbiased evaluation.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了机器人协同设计中控制学习与形态进化的相互作用，揭示了过早的适应度评估会偏向选择快速学习者并低估真实潜力，进而提出AdaControl方法通过调整学习时长实现无偏评估。
summary_zh: 通过双层优化实现的机器人协同设计，将生命周期内的控制器学习（用于适应度评估）与跨代形态进化相结合。已有研究证实，良好适配的形态有助于加快控制学习，这一特性被称为形态智能。然而，控制学习如何反过来影响形态进化仍未被探索。本文从两个方向进行考察，以全面理解大脑与身体的相互作用。我们首先证明，形态对控制学习的贡献可解耦为两个正交维度。我们将收敛速度形式化为形态智能，并将性能上限确定为一种互补量，称为真潜力。随后建立了一个简洁的函数关系，以从个体学习曲线中联合表征这两个量，当在种群层面聚合时，这些量能捕捉进化特征。通过对模拟体素软体机器人进行大量实验，我们发现，过早的适应度评估会系统性低估真潜力，并使选择偏向于学习较快的个体。这限制了设计空间的探索，同时损害了优化效率和形态多样性。值得注意的是，广泛公认的形态鲍德温效应实际上是这种偏差的产物，而非普遍的进化趋势。因此，我们提出了AdaControl方法，该方法在进化过程中监测对形态智能的不成比例选择，并分配最小足够的控制学习以实现无偏的适应度评估。采用AdaControl，一个简单的遗传算法在发现多样化的高性能设计方面可与最先进的基于生成模型的协同设计方法相媲美，同时相比穷举控制最多可减少80%的计算量。

title: Conformal Risk Minimization for Semi-Supervised Domain Adaptation via Optimal Transport
summary: In high-stakes healthcare applications, machine learning models are frequently trained on data from one patient population and deployed on another, creating a distribution shift that degrades both accuracy and reliability. Semi-Supervised Domain Adaptation (SSDA) addresses this by leveraging labeled data from some source domain to improve model performance on a target domain where labels are scarce. However, existing SSDA methods optimize primarily for point-prediction accuracy and offer no principled uncertainty quantification --- a prerequisite for clinical trust. Conformal Prediction (CP) can address this limitation by providing prediction sets with rigorous, distribution-free coverage guarantees. However, applying CP post-hoc to a pre-trained model can yield prohibitively large prediction sets, as SSDA pre-training methods do not account for the nonconformity score geometry that determines conformal set size. Conformal Risk Minimization (CRM) has been used to resolve this issue in the fully supervised setting by integrating the CP objective directly into model training, but it requires a large labeled dataset to compute nonconformity thresholds during training, precisely the data that is scarce in the SSDA regime. We propose an end-to-end framework that integrates CRM into the SSDA training objective, enabling effective CRM in the limited-labeled-target-data regime. The key idea is to utilize Optimal Transport (OT) to generate pseudolabels for unlabeled target instances, providing the additional training signal needed by CRM to operate using only a small labeled target set. This results in a model jointly optimized for domain invariance and conformal efficiency, producing prediction sets that are compact, coverage-valid, and support domain-specific constraints such as excluding mutually contradictory diagnoses in skin lesion classification.
tldr: This paper proposes an end-to-end framework that integrates Conformal Risk Minimization (CRM) into Semi-Supervised Domain Adaptation (SSDA) using Optimal Transport (OT) to generate pseudolabels, enabling compact and coverage-valid prediction sets for high-stakes healthcare applications like skin lesion classification.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种端到端框架，通过最优传输生成伪标签，将共形风险最小化集成到半监督领域自适应中，从而在皮肤病变分类等高风险医疗应用中产生紧凑且覆盖有效的预测集。
summary_zh: 在高风险的医疗应用中，机器学习模型常常基于某一患者群体的数据进行训练，却在另一群体上部署，由此产生的分布偏移会降低模型的准确性和可靠性。半监督域适应（SSDA）通过利用来自源域的标注数据来改善目标域（标签稀缺）上的模型性能，从而应对这一问题。然而，现有的SSDA方法主要针对点预测准确率进行优化，并未提供原则性的不确定性量化——而这正是临床可信赖性的前提条件。保形预测（CP）能够提供具有严格、无分布假设的覆盖保证的预测集，从而弥补这一不足。然而，将CP事后应用于预训练模型可能导致预测集过大，因为SSDA预训练方法并未考虑决定保形集大小的非一致性得分几何结构。保形风险最小化（CRM）通过将CP目标直接融入模型训练，已在全监督场景下解决了此问题，但其需要大规模标注数据集来在训练期间计算非一致性阈值，而这正是SSDA情景下所稀缺的数据。我们提出了一种端到端框架，将CRM融入SSDA训练目标，从而在有限标注目标数据场景下实现有效的CRM。其关键思想是利用最优传输（OT）为未标注目标实例生成伪标签，为CRM仅使用少量标注目标集即可运作提供所需的额外训练信号。由此得到的模型联合优化了域不变性和保形效率，生成的预测集紧凑、覆盖有效，并支持特定域约束，例如在皮肤病变分类中排除相互矛盾的诊断结果。

title: KMGen: A Skill-based Approach for Synthetic Individual Patient Data Generation
summary: Individual patient data (IPD) from clinical trials is the substrate for survival modeling, meta-analysis, and safety research, yet IPD is rarely released. Prior work has addressed only half of this gap: reconstructing Kaplan-Meier (KM) curves from published plots -- typically requiring manual digitization or human-in-the-loop correction -- while offering no mechanism for generating the adverse-event (AE) streams that constitute the other half of a patient record. We introduce KMGen, the first end-to-end framework that (i) fully automates KM curve extraction at accuracy competitive with human-guided tools, and (ii) generates synthetic per-patient AE trajectories from public trial registry records. The extraction stage is a fully automated agentic pipeline -- an agent generates code to extract each step in the KM curve -- achieving a mean Integrated Absolute Error (IAE) of 0.0151 on a 32-plot benchmark spanning clean, edge-case, and adversarial conditions. The IPD generation stage decouples patient archetype extraction from statistical sampling: an LLM distills the trial record into arm-specific statistics, adverse events, patient demographics, and risk multipliers. A mechanistic sampler generates patient events via clinical archetypes, bootstrap rank-correlation coupling to the empirical KM curve (preserving the marginal survival distribution exactly), and cycle-based AE scheduling with an induction/maintenance split. Across three held-out oncology trials spanning an order of magnitude in cohort size and 30 independent regenerations per trial, KMGen achieves mean integrated KM absolute difference $Δ_{\text{KM}}\,{\leq}\,0.051$, sex/ECOG JSD ${\leq}\,0.013$ on 5 of 6 demographic slots, and recovers ${\geq}\,71\%$ of the top-15 AEs by exact MedDRA term under a single fixed parameter set. The pipeline is released as open source at https://github.com/chufangao/kmgen.
tldr: KMGen is the first end-to-end framework that fully automates Kaplan-Meier curve extraction from published plots and generates synthetic patient-level adverse-event trajectories using LLM-based distillation and mechanistic sampling, achieving high accuracy on oncology trial benchmarks.
tldr_zh: KMGen 是首个端到端框架，可完全自动化地从已发表图表中提取 Kaplan-Meier 曲线，并利用基于大语言模型的提炼和机制采样生成合成患者级别的不良事件轨迹，在肿瘤学试验基准上实现了高精度。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
来自临床试验的个体患者数据（IPD）是生存建模、荟萃分析和安全性研究的基础，然而IPD很少被公开。先前的研究仅解决了这一缺口的一半：从已发表的图表中重建Kaplan-Meier（KM）曲线——通常需要手动数字化或人工在环校正——同时未能提供生成构成患者记录另一半的不良事件（AE）流的机制。我们提出KMGen，这是首个端到端框架，能够（i）以与人工引导工具竞争性的精度完全自动化提取KM曲线，以及（ii）从公开试验注册记录中生成合成性的每位患者AE轨迹。提取阶段是一个完全自动化的智能体流程——智能体生成代码以提取KM曲线中的每一步——在包含干净图、边缘情况图和对抗性图的32图基准测试中，实现了平均积分绝对误差（IAE）为0.0151。IPD生成阶段将患者原型提取与统计抽样解耦：大语言模型（LLM）将试验记录提炼为各治疗组特异性统计量、不良事件、患者人口统计学特征和风险乘数。一个机制性抽样器通过临床原型、基于自助法秩相关耦合至经验KM曲线（精确保留边际生存分布）、以及基于周期（诱导/维持分割）的AE调度来生成患者事件。在三个留出的肿瘤学试验中（队列规模跨越一个数量级，每个试验独立再生30次），KMGen实现了平均积分KM绝对差异$Δ_{\text{KM}}\,{\leq}\,0.051$，在6个人口统计学指标中的5个上性别/ECOG JSD ${\leq}\,0.013$，并在单一固定参数集下，按精确MedDRA术语恢复了前15个AE中的${\geq}\,71\%$。该流程已作为开源代码发布在https://github.com/chufangao/kmgen。
